subject: joule v0.1.9 — product icon + Authenticode-ready Windows pipeline
opening: v0.1.9 ships the joule product icon in Windows exe, Setup, macOS app, and Linux packages, plus an Authenticode sign path when a code-signing PFX secret is configured.

sections.heading: Added
items: Linux hicolor icons and Icon=joule desktop entry

sections.heading: Signing
sections.body: Without an OV/EV Authenticode certificate secret, Windows installers remain unsigned (SmartScreen may warn). Add the PFX as a GitHub Actions secret to sign on the next build.
